testcase.name: Scenario: Apply and restore a body appearance: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/body-properties/body-properties.feature:41:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply and restore a body appearance ✔ Given a part with a visible solid body is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the body appearance is set to As Part ✔ When the user opens Body Properties for the body from the model browser ✔ And the user selects Black in Body Appearance ✔ And the user chooses OK ✔ Then the dialog closes ✔ And the solid is displayed with the Black appearance ✔ When the user reopens Body Properties for the same body ✔ Then Body Appearance displays Black ✔ When the user selects As Part in Body Appearance ✔ And the user chooses OK ✔ Then the dialog closes ✔ And the solid is displayed with the part appearance
